name: CUPS
description: CodeRec User Programming States for annotating work with an AI code completion tool (Mozannar et al., CHI 2024). A fixed taxonomy, so custom labels are turned off.
source: State names and definitions from the CUPS labeling tool, https://github.com/microsoft/coderec_programming_states (MIT License, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation).

dimensions.label: State
dimensions.prompt: Which programming state were you in during this time interval?

options.hint: actively thinking/verifying about suggestion shown, also includes going to the internet to verify
decide to not think now about suggestion, but will think later about it

options.value: Thinking About New Code To Write
options.hint: thinking about code outside suggestions to write, new functionality
waiting for Copilot suggestion to be shown
writing code that implements new functionality
editing code you wrote that was not a Copilot suggestion for purpose of fixing functionality
writing comment or code with intention of copilot completion
adding comments for purpose of documentation
running or debugging code to check functionality, may include writing tests or debugging statements
going online to look up code or documentation
